                                          BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2015-001

        Supersedes:           None

               Issuer:        Alan Price, P.E.
                              Director, Office of Technical Certification and Research

     Issuance Date:           January 28, 2015

            Purpose:          This document establishes acceptance criteria for sandwich panels used for the construction
                              of exterior walls as an alternative material in the NYC Construction Codes.

           Related            BC     28-113.2.2          BC    1404.1
       Code/Zoning            BC     28-113.2.3          BC    1405.1
        Section(s):           BC     1704.10

          Subject(s):         Exterior walls, sandwich panels; Exterior walls, non-loading bearing, sandwich wall panels


      Background:         Section BC 1404 prescribes the use of materials for the construction of exterior walls.
                          However such section does not prescribe the use of sandwich panels for the construction of
                          exterior walls (sandwich wall panels). This bulletin establishes criteria for the acceptance of
                          sandwich wall panels used on the exterior.

       Description:       Sandwich wall panels are as described in Section 2.0 of ICC ES AC 04 “Acceptance Criteria
                                                1
                          for Sandwich Panels”.

Evaluation Scope:         NYC Construction Codes

          Evaluation      Pursuant to section AC 28-113, the Office of Technical Certification and Research (OTCR)
            Criteria:     recognizes sandwich wall panels tested and evaluated in accordance with ICC ES AC 04
                          “Acceptance Criteria for Sandwich Panels”.

                          Acceptable sandwich wall panels shall have an evaluation or code compliance report issued in
                          accordance with ICC ES AC 04 and must comply with the conditions of this bulletin. The agency
                          providing the evaluation or code compliance report shall be accredited to ISO 17065.

                Uses:     Sandwich wall panels are used as a non-load bearing exterior wall panel for combustible and
                          noncombustible construction.

      Conditions of       Sandwich wall panels shall comply with NYC Construction Codes and the following applicable
       Acceptance:        provisions:

                          A. Design

                          Exterior sandwich wall panels shall be designed in accordance with the NYC Construction
                          Codes, manufacturer’s installation instructions and conditions of the evaluation or code
                          compliance report issued for the installed product subject to the compliance of fire separation
                          requirement of Chapter 7 of the NYC Construction Codes, as applicable.

                          B. Installation Requirements

                          1. Installation requirements shall be in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions, the
                             evaluation or code compliance report issued for the installed product, and the conditions of this
                             bulletin.

                          C. Inspections

                          1. Pursuant to section BC 1704.10, the installation of exterior sandwich wall panels shall be
                             subject to special inspection requirements of Chapter 17 of the Building Code and Department
                             Rules covering special inspection.

                          D. Labeling

                          1. Exterior sandwich wall panels shall be labeled as per section BC 28-113.2.3. All shipments
                             and deliveries of materials shall be accompanied by a certificate or label certifying that the
                             materials shipped or delivered are equivalent to those tested and approved.

         Referenced 1. AC 04 –“Acceptance Criteria for Sandwich Panels”.
